needs.description: High-quality puppy formula appropriate for a 6-month-old, medium-to-large-stature dog with controlled calories to limit excess weight gain. 15–30 lb bag (depending on feeding plan) from Mars brands (e.g., Royal Canin puppy or similar Mars-formulated puppy line) that specifically lists protein sources but excludes duck. Look for formulas that support joint development and have measured calories per cup so portions can be limited.
needs.rationale: Daily food is a required consumable. AJ is 6 months and already 40 lb (overweight for a Pug body type); he still needs growth nutrition but with calorie control to avoid accelerating excess weight. Use a puppy formula that avoids his allergen (duck) and fits the owner's Mars brand bias and moderate budget.
evidence: standard: growth_nutrition_guideline (use age-appropriate complete diet; control calories for overweight juveniles)

needs.family: Daily water bowl (shallow, wide stainless steel)
needs.description: A sturdy, shallow, wide stainless-steel water bowl (non-tip base, 64–96 oz capacity) sized for a low-slung brachycephalic face. Stainless resists bacteria/odor and is dishwasher-safe. Keep at ground level to avoid nasal congestion when drinking.
needs.rationale: Fresh water is a daily consumable and critical especially during heat alerts. Pugs have short muzzles—shallow wide bowls are more comfortable and safer for breathing while drinking.
evidence: standard: water_access_guideline (constant access to fresh water)

needs.description: High-quality cooling mat sized for ~40 lb dog (approx 28–32" length pad or medium/large depending on product). Non-toxic gel or evaporative fabric that is easy to clean, non-slip, and works indoors in the apartment to lower body temperature quickly.
needs.rationale: Immediate safety need due to an active excessive heat warning plus AJ’s brachycephalic anatomy (Pugs are at high risk of heat stress). Without a cooling surface in the apartment right now, AJ faces a heat-related health risk.
evidence: standard: brachycephalic_heat_safety_guideline (avoid overheating; provide cooling options)

needs.description: Durable, properly sized no-pull harness (front-clip option) rated for strong pullers, with multiple adjustment points to fit AJ’s chest at 6 months/40 lb. Material should be chew-resistant (nylon with reinforced stitching). Include matching heavy-duty leash (6 ft) for apartment walks and yard work.
needs.rationale: AJ is described as very energetic and very strong with strong chew strength. A secure harness and leash are immediate safety items to prevent neck injury, escapes, and leash-related accidents during walks or sudden noises during hunting/leaf blower season.
evidence: pet_characteristic: about: "AJ is very energetic and very strong."
standard: leash_harness_safety_guideline (avoid neck strain; escape-proof harnesses for brachycephalic & strong dogs)

needs.description: Dispenser-ready roll(s) of sturdy, leak-resistant biodegradable poop bags for daily apartment walks; include a small clip-on dispenser for the leash.
needs.rationale: Daily consumable required on every walk. In an apartment setting and with a large yard used sometimes, owner will use these daily for sanitation and local regulations.
evidence: standard: local_sanitation_guideline (carry waste bags on walks)

needs.description: Combination deshedding kit sized for short-to-medium coat Pugs — undercoat rake and slicker brush to reduce loose hair during fall shedding season. Easy-clean, ergonomic handles; suitable for weekly to several-times-weekly use.
needs.rationale: Calendar indicates Fall Shedding Season and AJ's breed sheds; regular deshedding prevents excessive hair in apartment, reduces allergens and matting.
evidence: standard: seasonal_grooming_guideline (increase grooming during shedding seasons)

needs.description: Dog toothbrush (double-headed or finger brush) and enzymatic toothpaste flavored to appeal to dogs (non-duck formula). Start gentle daily brushing; recommended introduction now (6 months) as dental care begins around 6–8 months.
needs.rationale: Veterinary best practice is to begin regular dental care in puppies around 6–8 months to prevent plaque buildup. AJ is at the age where initiating brushing now will establish a routine.

needs.description: Floor digital scale accurate to 0.1–0.2 lb for tracking AJ’s weight at home. Compact model for apartment use; helps monitor weight trends weekly.
needs.rationale: AJ is unusually heavy for the Pug body type at 40 lb. Regular weight tracking is a preventive measure to manage obesity and monitor growth velocity in this juvenile period.
evidence: standard: weight_management_guideline (monitor weight regularly for overweight/obese patients)

needs.description: Clear graduated measuring cup (or food scale) for accurate portion control by cup or grams to match calorie-controlled feeding recommendations.
needs.rationale: Portion control is key for AJ’s overweight status. Accurate measuring tools prevent accidental overfeeding and support any weight-management feeding plan.
evidence: standard: portion_control_guideline (use measured portions to manage weight)

needs.description: Plastic or ceramic slow-feed bowl with gentle ridges sized for a pug nose (medium-sized labyrinth pattern) to slow gulping and reduce risk of regurgitation.
needs.rationale: High activity and overeating can lead to gulping; brachycephalic breeds are at increased risk of respiratory compromise when gulping. Slow feeders reduce speed of ingestion, improving digestion and weight control.
evidence: standard: feeding_speed_guideline (slow feeders for fast eaters)

needs.family: Durable chew toys (KONG Extreme / tough rubber)
needs.description: Extra-durable, unfilled rubber/nylon chew toys rated for strong chewers and sized for a 40 lb dog (KONG Extreme or similar). Avoid rawhide and edible chews that might contain duck. Use for supervised chew sessions and stuffing with safe treats.
needs.rationale: AJ has strong chew strength; appropriate durable chews protect household items, satisfy teething/chewing drive, and support dental abrasion without medications.
evidence: pet_characteristic: about: "AJ is very energetic and very strong."
standard: chew_safety_guideline (offer durable, non-ingestible chews for strong chewers)

needs.description: Clip-on rechargeable LED light and reflective striping for harness or collar for dusk/dawn and hunting season visibility. Lightweight and water-resistant.
needs.rationale: Hunting season and shorter daylight hours increase risk on walks. Reflective and illuminated gear improves safety in low-light conditions for apartment owners who walk at dawn/dusk.
evidence: standard: visibility_guideline (use lights/reflective gear during low light)

needs.description: Small, soft training treats (pea- or chicken-based or other single-protein options but explicitly not duck) in a resealable bag for frequent reward-based training. Budget-moderate brands available from Mars’ portfolio or equivalents.
needs.rationale: AJ is energetic; positive reinforcement with small, frequent treats supports obedience and impulse control. Avoid duck due to allergy.

needs.description: Basic clicker, target stick, and short training guide for puppy adolescent behavior shaping. Compact and inexpensive to use indoors in an apartment.
needs.rationale: AJ is at a developmental stage (6 months) where structure and training reduce problem behaviors associated with high energy. Clicker training is evidence-based for consistent cueing.

needs.description: Pheromone diffuser (Adaptil-style) for apartment rooms where AJ spends most time to reduce anxiety related to leaf blowers and hunting season noises.
needs.rationale: Calendar triggers include leaf blower and hunting season—noise can trigger stress. A pheromone diffuser is a non-medical preventive calming aid appropriate for apartments.
evidence: standard: nonpharmacologic_anxiety_guideline (use pheromone diffusers for noise-related stress)

needs.family: Portable dog water bottle / travel bowl
needs.description: Squeeze-bottle style portable dog water bottle with attached bowl for walks and yard play; 12–20 oz capacity, leakproof, easy-clean.
needs.rationale: During hot weather and outings to the yard, portable hydration prevents dehydration and is a helpful adjunct to the home water bowl.
evidence: standard: hydration_guideline (carry water on walks in hot weather)

needs.description: Moderately challenging treat-dispensing puzzle toy appropriate for a strong, intelligent 6-month-old dog; durable construction and dishwasher-safe. Use with non-duck treats.
needs.rationale: Provides mental stimulation in apartment settings and on rainy days (rain season upcoming). Helps channel AJ’s high energy and reduce boredom.
evidence: standard: enrichment_guideline (puzzle toys for mental stimulation)

needs.description: Snuffle mat sized for a medium activity dog; multiple fabric pockets to hide kibble or treats for scent enrichment.
needs.rationale: Scent work is calming and mentally tiring for energetic dogs—useful indoors during bad weather or when noise keeps AJ inside.
evidence: standard: enrichment_guideline (sniffing activities reduce excess energy)

needs.description: High-durability balls sized for a medium dog and manual launcher for backyard use (appropriate for large yard). Durable, easy to clean components.
needs.rationale: AJ is highly active and a large yard is available—structured fetch sessions provide healthy exercise without over-exertion in hot conditions if scheduled appropriately.
evidence: standard: exercise_guideline (structured play in safe conditions)

needs.description: Heavy-duty tug rope toy for interactive owner-dog play; reinforced ends and knotting for durability. Use supervised to teach release cues.
needs.rationale: High-energy dogs benefit from owner-play sessions. Tug builds impulse control and offers a bonding outlet while burning energy.
evidence: pet_characteristic: about: "AJ is very energetic and very strong."
standard: play_guideline (structured interactive play reduces behavioral issues)

needs.description: Low-impact agility equipment (tunnels, low jumps, weave poles) sized for juvenile dogs; adjustable height to protect joints and accommodate growth.
needs.rationale: AJ is high-energy and the large yard enables structured physical enrichment that develops coordination and provides exercise without long endurance runs that can overheat a brachycephalic dog.
evidence: standard: exercise_guideline (use short bouts of activity; avoid prolonged exertion in brachycephalics)

needs.description: Lightweight waterproof dog raincoat sized to AJ’s current dimensions (adjustable straps to grow through adolescence) with a belly coverage design to keep him drier on rainy Seattle/Pacific NW days.
needs.rationale: Rain season starts in the calendar context; a raincoat increases comfort for walks and reduces the frequency of full baths and chill after wet outings.
evidence: standard: seasonal_gear_guideline (use rain gear in wet climates)

needs.description: Washable medium-sized bolster or low-orthopedic bed sized for a growing dog (~30" x 20") that provides support and insulation in an apartment; machine-washable cover for easy cleaning during shedding/allergy season.
needs.rationale: Good sleep surfaces support recovery after active play and reduce joint stress over the long term. Washable covers help control allergens in the apartment.
evidence: standard: comfort_guideline (supportive bedding for active juveniles)

needs.description: Durable, low-sided collapsible pool suitable for backyard cooling and supervised play; size for medium dog and easy to drain and store.
needs.rationale: Provides a cooling, fun outlet during heat waves and is a safe, low-exertion way to help AJ cool off when supervised outdoors in the yard.
evidence: standard: heat_relief_guideline (supervised water play can help cooling)

needs.description: Indoor pet camera for apartment monitoring, two-way audio and optional treat dispenser. Helps owner check on AJ, administer remote rewards, and monitor for noise/anxiety triggers while away.
needs.rationale: Apartment living plus noise-related stressors (leaf blowers, hunting) and the owner’s need to manage a high-energy adolescent make remote monitoring and interaction useful for behavior management and peace of mind.
evidence: standard: remote_monitoring_guideline (use cameras to monitor behavior and intervene if anxious)

needs.description: Simple scent-work toys or instructional kit to introduce nosework at home (scented pads, small containers) and structured search games for indoor enrichment.
needs.rationale: High mental outlet for an intelligent, energetic dog—especially valuable during rainy periods or when outdoor activity is limited.
evidence: standard: enrichment_guideline (use nosework for mental stimulation)
